sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 4.39 per unit (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have carefully reviewed your data regarding past orders and the forecasted volume increase. As to the price history and volume change data you cited, that does not change our position. 

We are willing to accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms. To support these extended terms, our best possible unit price is €4.94. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our present Angebot is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer. We truly value our long-standing relationship and always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory, top-tier service, and reliable supply capabilities. 

Regarding your request, unfortunately, we cannot offer any further price reductions for this package. We must therefore maintain our offer of €4.94 per unit for a 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms. Please note that our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Kindly note that our proposal remains valid for 7 days. We hope these terms align with your planning, and we look forward to continuing our successful partnership.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

decisions.tactician: Option o7 (pay 90 d, 36 months) gives the supplier the multi-year volume commitment it says is the only thing that changes its prices. The 36 months is worth more to it than the cash model counts, so it may accept a lower price on these terms. Among rungs other than E0, step_10 gives our lowest C (€171,423) while leaving room to concede. E0 sits slightly lower at €4.22 on the same terms. Since step_10 is the code-defined next step, it reads as credible movement and is still far below the €4.96 quote. The 12-month midway rungs (o1–o5) cost us about €12k more and ignore what the supplier wants. Arguments a2 (rising forecast) and a3 (order history at €4.39) support the volume case and anchor the price. I left out the 85 % on-time record to keep the tone constructive with an account that already treats us as non-strategic.

decisions.tactician: We stay on the same 36-month, 90-day terms because they match its stated needs and isolate price as the only open point. why.tactician: The supplier is at final_offer after three identical replies and we have no new arguments. A counter on o2 (step rungs at €4.75–4.84) risks a walk-away from a supplier that is already deprioritising us. Losing the deal would leave us with our alternative at C €203,169. offer:70620-3 gives C €196,853, the best standing sheet and below the accept limit of €198,846. The other options at its_level gain at most about €30 (o5/o6) and would need a new round, which could reopen the price. Accepting locks in the gain over the opening quote safely, which is better than a further E0-style counter.
